newsitem.title: USA: KKR reaps huge profit from Duracell sale.
newsitem.headline: KKR reaps huge profit from Duracell sale.

text.p: Gillette Co.'s planned $7 billion acquisition of Duracell International Inc. should prove to be a gigantic windfall for leveraged buy-out specialist Kohlberg Kravis & Roberts Co.

The savvy Wall Street firm bought Duracell in 1988 for $350 million and expects to turn that initial investment into more than $3.2 billion when the sale of Duracell goes through, a KKR spokeswoman said Thursday.
The Duracell transaction marks the second time in the past month that KKR pulled in a huge profit through the sale of its holdings.

It agreed in August to sell its 64 percent stake in American Re Corp. to Munich Reinsurance Co for $3.3 billion, bringing the firm an aggregrate return of about $2 billion from its initial $300 million investment.
